prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1339; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all future communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page for the insured driver, including the bodily injury and property damage liability limits in force at the time of the accident, along with any other coverage that may apply. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella policies exist.

Finally, we request that your company preserve all evidence related to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, and any electronic records. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of these materials while the claim is pending. We look forward to your prompt written response.
